notes: Opt-in standard UDS (ISO 14229) read-only diagnostics only, where the selected ECU answers ISO 15765-4 11-bit CAN at 500 kbit/s on a physical diagnostic ID pair (0x7E0-0x7E7 request, +8 response). Not established for any particular motorcycle. Synthetic integration tests only. Read-only services only: DiagnosticSessionControl default/extended, ReadDataByIdentifier (0x22), ReadDTCInformation (0x19), TesterPresent; every write, clear, security, routine, memory and programming service is refused before transmission. Requires a correct CAN adapter and the physical ECU ID pair.

session.physical_evidence_note: Standard ISO 14229 read-only services only; no model-specific fitment is claimed. This integration is synthetic-tested only.

identification.note: UDS ReadDataByIdentifier DID F190 (VIN), reported as an unverified response - not confirmed ECU hardware identity or any programming authorization.

memory.write_blocked_reason: The generic UDS profile exposes no memory read and no write path; ReadMemoryByAddress (0x23) and the transfer services are not in the read-only allowlist.
